title: Homological criterion for the scalar Q biproduct
statement: In the setting of [lem-sfb-rational-p1-scalar-q-right-inverse], the q twisted unit and scalar Chern arrow have the projective-line homology concentration in degrees -2 and 0, the pushforward target vanishes in all other degrees, and the induced homology maps at -2 and 0 are isomorphisms.

source.place: Second identity, scalar trace base change before tensoring with q*K; homological concentration of the q unit/Chern components

proof.text: Evaluate the normalized completed splitting on strict constant systems, transport both components through completion, realization and scalar extension, and use projective-line cohomological concentration in degrees 0 and -2. The normalization identifies the degree-zero component with scalarQChern and the degree-minus-two component with scalarTwistedUnit; endpoint comparisons preserve invertibility.

proof_origin.place: Second identity, homological concentration and component invertibility

mathlib_searches.results: Generic derived-category homology isomorphism criteria; no geometric q transport theorem.

theorem scalar_q_chern_homology_criterion
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (c : Option (PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField l))
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP k p] (hpl : p ≠ l)
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) [Y.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [IsNoetherian Y] [IsNoetherian (ProjectiveLine Y)] [IsNoetherian (diagonalSurface Y)]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l Y]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l (ProjectiveLine Y)]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l (diagonalSurface Y)]
    (δ : diagonalCompletedDomain l Y ⟶ diagonalCompletedCodomain l Y)
    (family : Family l Y) (r : Reference l Y δ family)
    (a : DiagonalTrace.completedUnit l Y ⟶
      r.tq.Rc.R.obj ((DiagonalTrace.completedLine l (ProjectiveLine Y)) ⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧))
    (ha : CompletedChernNormalized l r.tq.toPresentation a)
    (b : DiagonalTrace.completedUnit l (ProjectiveLine Y) ⟶
      r.t₂.Rc.R.obj ((DiagonalTrace.completedLine l (diagonalSurface Y)) ⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧))
    (hb : CompletedChernNormalized l r.t₂.toPresentation b) :
    let Λ := (coefficient l c).X
    let T := fun X : Scheme.{u} ↦
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Modules Λ X) 0).obj (line l c X)) ⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧
    let uq := scalarTwistedUnit Λ (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y) (T Y) (T (ProjectiveLine Y))
      (scalarQLineIso l c k p hpl Y)
    let cq := scalarQChern l c Y r a
    let U := unit Λ Y
    let V := T Y
    let K := (moduleObjectDerivedPushforward Λ (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y)).obj
      (T (ProjectiveLine Y))
    (∀ n : ℤ, n ≠ 0 → IsZero
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (Modules Λ Y) n).obj U)) ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, n ≠ -2 → IsZero
        ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (Modules Λ Y) n).obj V)) ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, n ≠ 0 → n ≠ -2 → IsZero
        ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (Modules Λ Y) n).obj K)) ∧
      IsIso ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (Modules Λ Y) 0).map cq) ∧
      IsIso ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (Modules Λ Y) (-2)).map uq)
